text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Tamamo Cross and I have
finished
shopping...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Creek, Oguri, you two really
turned up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, we got a farm to get to! Lead
the way,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I just can't wait to pet all the
different
animals! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Milk, cheese, yogurt... I bet there'll be
all kinds of
tasty things to try.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Creek 'n Oguri are headin' to their
stuff, so
let's get going too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How to felt a coaster out of wool. Now
where's
the class... Oh, over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'm gonna make 'em a real nice—

text_block_list.name: Cows
text_block_list.text: Moooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caretaker
text_block_list.text: STOOOP! The stables are this waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We gotta move fast! Those cows are
chargin'
straight at Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aw, aren't you the sweetest little sheep?
And I
bet you goats want some headpats
too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're da reason they're all comin' over?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Their poor caretaker's in a real panic, so let's send the livestock back where they're supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, all the animals are back where they belong... Now I can finally get back to makin' coasters...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, Tama and Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Did you want me to hang out with you?
Sorry, but
I've got my hands full
transporting this milk.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And why exactly are you luggin' that around? Shouldn't the staff be doin' that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, the ice cream here is just so
delicious that I
went and ate their entire
stock... before the other
customers could
even get a scoop...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm helping them out with the milk by
way of an
apology. They can use this
milk to make more ice
cream.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guess that explains it! Well, lemme give
ya a
hand! Four hands'll get the job
done faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time passes as we lug the milk barrels
around
together, and the farm shutters
for the day...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Tama... You were so busy helping
me that
you missed out on making your
coaster.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry too... Taking the animals back
to their
pens must have taken you some
time as well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey c'mon! It's all good! I had a load of
fun, and I
got no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ('Sides...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Wowww! That shop's even bigger than
our place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Brother
text_block_list.text:
And there's so many of 'em! Tama, I
wanna check
out that one!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, don't run! If you wanna go
someplace,
you gotta wait for your big
sis!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Siblings
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Man, it feels like we walked a
marathon! My
legs're stiff as a board
here.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Eh, but lookin' at those smiles, I feel
like... it was
worth it.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was a long, hectic day for sure, but we
all had a
good time, right? 'Cause that's
what matters!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess we're gonna be on this bus
for a
while, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Today was quite a workout. Y'know, I
think... I
might be... spent...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It looks like Tamtam's drifted
right off to
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz... Th... anks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Tamamo Cross's peaceful
sleeping
face, I feel my heart warming.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Mountain-climbing, beach
party—you
name it, I'm there. I'd have a
blast goin' anywhere
with you guys!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to chaperone anything you
want,
Tamtam. Leave all the planning to
mommy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If Creek's going to be the mom, then...
I'll be the
dad. Tama, say the word and
Dad'll make it
happen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, not this again! You're as bad as
da taiyaki
guy. I! AM NOT! A KID!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so our trip to the farm comes to an
end on a
laid-back note.
